hooks.description: After the agent saves any JS, HTML, or CSS file, syntax-check all JS files and run the full test suite so regressions surface immediately.
hooks.name: Check and test on save

action.prompt: The spec task just finished. Update the checkbox for this task in the spec's tasks.md (mark it [x] only if it is truly complete and verified), and append a short note there if the implementation deviated from design.md in any way.

hooks.description: After a spec task finishes, remind the agent to update the tasks.md checkbox and record any deviation from the design.
hooks.name: Keep spec tasks in sync
